name: supern
description: Tiny browser tools. Currently: a daily time-block for distracting sites.

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename supern.xpi --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts scripts CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. content/speed-preview.html .claude .env
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts scripts CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. content/speed-preview.html .claude .env
scripts.install-local: npm run build && npm run install-ext
scripts.release: npm run sign && npm run install-ext
